skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Know and understand the functions, commands, views, and tables of Microsoft Project. Use commands to set schedules for projects, create work plans.
Understand and apply software to manage project resources such as allocation and balancing resources.
Know, understand, and apply Microsoft Project software to manage costs and monitor projects.
Use software to manage the project implementation process, able to apply and analyze differences between project plans and actual project implementation, manage and analyze project information.
Have the ability to use IT software to manage projects.
Form the ability to be proactive in learning, work independently, identify problems, analyze and solve problems.
Collaborate and participate in group activities to complete group tasks effectively.
